City of Encinitas
Commission for the Arts
AGENDA
NOVEMBER 7, 2022 -
05:00 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS None
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF Each speaker has three (3) minutes to address the Commission for the Arts using the New Public Comment Procedures outlined above. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to City Staff either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES Approve the October 3, 2022 regular meeting minutes.
7. October 3, 2022 regular meeting minutes
8.
ACTION ITEMS
8A.
Encinitas Holiday Parade Participation
Discuss and determine the Commission’s level of participation in the annual Holiday Parade.
8A. Encinitas Holiday Parade Participation
8B.
Arts Supervisor Interview Panelist
Appoint one commissioner to be a panelist for the qualifying interviews.
8B. Arts Supervisor Interview Panelist
8C.
Pacific View Color Palette Focus Group
Appoint one commissioner to be a member of the Pacific View color palette focus group.
8C. Pacific View Color Palette Focus Group
8D.
Donation of Artwork
Review the Application for Donation of Artwork and make a recommendation to Council.
8D. Donation of Artwork
8E.
Commission for the Arts Annual Work Plan
Review the FY 2022/23 Work Plan and report on progress.
8E. Commission for the Arts Annual Work Plan
9.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
9A.
Cultural Arts Division Report – Arts Administrator Murphy
9B.
Commission Calendar -- Arts Administrator Murphy
1.
Wednesdays@Noon concerts: November 2, 9, 16, 23, and 30, Encinitas Library
2.
Music by the Sea: November 18, Encinitas Library
3.
Art Night: November 19, Encinitas Library, Community Center, City Hall, and others
9C.
Encinitas Friends of the Arts Report – Commissioner Valenzuela
10.
COMMISSION MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM Commissioner prepared and presented agenda items.
11.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COMMISSION MEMBERS Future agenda items may be request with consensus of two or more Commissioners.
12.
COMMISSIONERS’ REPORTS
ADJOURNMENT
